title: Deciphering Cancer-Specific H3K27ac Landscapes Through Systematic Multi-Omics Integration and Development of Open-Access Genomic Annotation Platform.
snippet: H3K27ac epigenetically modulates gene expression and serves as an indicator of cancer status.
